header: This is the "Utility Services" tab of the user guide (text and data in src/lib/help/utilityServices.ts): what the services are, how to get any of them, each service by its bold name with the words that open it (click them to put them in the search bar), the calculators menu, the sample questions of the services (I pass them in as children, because that block belongs to the guide's own file), and what they cannot do yet.
